selection: the MyInstants Hall of Fame and TikTok Trends pages, plus picks made while cutting videos

sounds.title: Vine Boom
sounds.story: A Bluezone Corporation impact from 2012 became a Vine reveal cue through King Bach's 2014 edits, then a staple of ironic short-form cuts.
sounds.common_use: A face, object, or fact is revealed in one hard cut.

sounds.title: Bruh
sounds.story: Headgraphix's disappointed "bruh" accompanied a 2014 Vine; the isolated response returned in 2018 reaction edits about embarrassment and defeat.
sounds.common_use: A dry, one-word verdict on an obvious mistake.

sounds.title: Wrong-answer buzzer
sounds.story: A game-show wrong-answer cue recirculated as a soundboard button. The recording's original show, maker, and uploader are not identified here.
sounds.common_use: Reject a guess or instantly grade a failed attempt.

sounds.title: Anime Wow
sounds.story: The high-pitched exclamation traces to the 1990 arcade game Parodius Da! and spread through Japanese TV and anime before Western montage edits.
sounds.common_use: Exaggerate a strangely impressive or surprising reveal.

sounds.title: Discord Notification
sounds.story: Discord's incoming-message chime became recognizable enough to work as an out-of-context interruption in streams and screen-recording edits.
sounds.common_use: An unseen sender or interface interrupts a scene.

sounds.title: Taco Bell Bong
sounds.story: Taco Bell used the bell in advertising from about 2000; 2020 edits turned the brand cue into an oversized impact and absurd reveal.
sounds.common_use: Give a small gesture the weight of a ceremonial gong.

sounds.title: MLG Air Horn
sounds.story: Air-horn sampling moved from dancehall and sports into 2010s YouTube montage parodies, where it mocked over-edited moments of triumph.
sounds.common_use: Celebrate a trivial success as if it were an esports final.

sounds.title: Roblox Oof
sounds.story: Roblox's avatar-death grunt became a shorthand for a tiny defeat. Its recording also appears in the 2000 game Messiah; ownership has been disputed.
sounds.common_use: Punctuate a harmless fall or failed move.

sounds.title: SpongeBob Fail
sounds.story: The uploader identifies this as the end-of-episode cue from SpongeBob SquarePants season three's "Missing Identity"; edits reuse it for failure.
sounds.common_use: Finish a failed search or awkward realization.

sounds.title: Fart with Reverb
sounds.story: A flatulence gag given a large, solemn room sound. The original recording and the person who made this particular reverb edit are unverified.
sounds.common_use: Make a lowbrow interruption absurdly monumental.

sounds.title: Sad Violin
sounds.story: "Sad Violin" edits commonly use Ji Pyeongkeyon's "Sad Romance" from a Korean TV drama. The exact recording in this MyInstants upload is unverified.
sounds.common_use: Treat a minor disappointment as a tragic loss.

sounds.title: Rizz Sound Effect
sounds.story: "Rizz" became a social-media word for flirtatious confidence through Kai Cenat's streams and TikTok. This button's particular music source is unverified.
sounds.common_use: Undercut an attempted suave entrance or pose.

sounds.title: Apple Pay
sounds.story: The iPhone payment-success cue escaped checkout screens and became a reaction sound for small wins, payments, and sudden value judgments.
sounds.common_use: A transaction or approval succeeds instantly.

sounds.title: Among Us Role Reveal
sounds.story: Among Us announces hidden roles before a round; after the game's 2020 streamer surge, the reveal screen and sound became suspect-reveal memes.
sounds.common_use: Identify a suspicious person or object with mock certainty.

sounds.title: Metal Pipe Clang
sounds.story: A falling-pipe clang surfaced in 2020 YouTube edits and became an abrupt ironic punchline. Claims that it comes from Battlefield 4 remain unconfirmed.
sounds.common_use: Hit a cut with an unexpectedly large, physical clang.

sounds.title: Emotional Damage
sounds.story: Steven He's line comes from his September 2021 comedy sketch "When 'Asian' Is a Difficulty Mode" and spread as a reaction to a verbal blow.
sounds.common_use: Cap a roast or an unexpectedly harsh personal verdict.

sounds.title: Metal Gear Solid Alert
sounds.story: The Metal Gear Solid games use the alert cue when an enemy spots the player; image edits borrowed its exclamation-mark moment for detection.
sounds.common_use: Someone notices a hidden subject at once.

sounds.title: Windows XP Error
sounds.story: A Windows XP error chime turned into a familiar cue for a frozen thought or a failed computer action. This upload's exact system-file match is unverified.
sounds.common_use: Interrupt a task with an old-computer failure.

sounds.title: Prowler Sting
sounds.story: The Prowler's motif comes from Daniel Pemberton's score for the 2018 film Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse; later edits used it for ominous stares.
sounds.common_use: Turn a mild look into an excessive threat.

sounds.title: The Price Is Right Losing Horn
sounds.story: The game show's loss fanfare, known as "The Lose," became a stock verdict for failed guesses well beyond The Price Is Right.
sounds.common_use: A contest, bargain, or confident guess fails completely.

sounds.title: Coffin Dance
sounds.story: Videos of Ghanaian dancing pallbearers were paired with Tony Igy's "Astronomia" in 2020 edits that cut from an impending fail to a funeral dance.
sounds.common_use: Signal that a reckless move has a predictable bad outcome.

sounds.title: Oh No TikTok
sounds.story: Capone's "Oh No" samples the Shangri-Las' "Remember (Walking in the Sand)." TikTok edits freeze just before a mistake and let the hook predict it.
sounds.common_use: Freeze and zoom on the frame before a visible disaster.

sounds.title: FAAAH
sounds.story: The page credits the exclamation to Taileons. Its earlier recording and first meme use are unverified.
sounds.common_use: An abrupt human yell on a jump cut.

sounds.title: baby laughing meme
sounds.story: A baby-laugh recording circulated as a reaction button. The child, recorder, and first upload are not identified on this page.
sounds.common_use: A cute or mocking laugh after a simple mistake.

sounds.title: Punch Sound
sounds.story: This upload labels a compact gaming punch effect. Its game or recording source is not identified.
sounds.common_use: Punctuate a fast physical hit or match cut.

sounds.title: spiderman meme song
sounds.story: The upload presents a Spider-Man-themed meme music clip. Its original track and edit source are unverified.
sounds.common_use: Play over a deliberately clumsy heroic entrance.

sounds.title: instagram thud
sounds.story: This page offers a separate Vine-boom recording under the name Instagram thud. The boom became a short-form reveal cue.
sounds.common_use: Hit a visual reveal with a deep thud.

sounds.title: dun dun dunnnnnnnn
sounds.story: A brass dramatic-sting recording sold as a sound effect. The exact performance and source are unverified.
sounds.common_use: Overstate a small mystery or discovery.

sounds.title: cat laugh meme 1
sounds.story: This cat-laugh or wheeze clip circulates as an animal reaction sound. The original animal video is unverified.
sounds.common_use: A strange laugh after an awkward claim.

sounds.title: Galaxy meme
sounds.story: The page calls this Brain Meme, tying it to the escalating Galaxy Brain joke. The music or effect inside this upload is not credited.
sounds.common_use: Mark an obviously bad idea as genius.

sounds.title: Fart Meme Sound
sounds.story: An uncredited flatulence sound was uploaded as a stand-alone meme button.
sounds.common_use: Break a serious silence with a crude interruption.

sounds.title: RUN vine
sounds.story: Vine edits used the cue from AWOLNATION’s Run when a sudden threat sent the subject fleeing.
sounds.common_use: Cut from spotting danger to immediate escape.

sounds.title: Dexter meme
sounds.story: The page labels this a Dexter meme clip but does not identify its scene, speaker, or music. Its precise origin remains unverified.
sounds.common_use: Frame a harmless routine as a secretive crime drama.

sounds.title: *Snore* mimimimimimi
sounds.story: A looping comic snore with a “mimimi” rhythm circulated as a reaction sound. The original performer is unverified.
sounds.common_use: Show boredom or instant sleep.

sounds.title: Oh My God Meme
sounds.story: This upload is labelled Oh My God Meme. The page does not identify which of the several viral “oh my God” recordings it contains.
sounds.common_use: React to a surprising reveal with exaggerated shock.

sounds.title: WIDE PUTIN MEME
sounds.story: The wide-walk edit stretched inauguration footage of Vladimir Putin over Piano Fantasia’s Song for Denise in 2020.
sounds.common_use: Score an unnaturally confident slow walk.

sounds.title: Du bist gut genug
sounds.story: The uploader identifies the clip as part of Blumengarten’s Du bist gut genug, used in TikTok edits. This cut’s exact release or edit is unverified.
sounds.common_use: Turn a small reassurance into an earnest or ironic beat.

sounds.title: Wow Anime meme
sounds.story: A shorter upload of the Anime Wow exclamation, whose sound traces to the 1990 arcade game Parodius Da!.
sounds.common_use: Celebrate a tiny reveal in an overexcited voice.

sounds.title: French meme song
sounds.story: The page gives this music clip only a generic French meme title; artist, composition, and first meme use are unverified.
sounds.common_use: Give an ordinary action an incongruously French music cue.

sounds.title: 'What' Bottom Text Meme (Sanctuary Guardian) - S
sounds.story: EarthBound’s Sanctuary Guardian battle music moved into ironic WHAT and HOW poster edits in 2020.
sounds.common_use: Accompany a baffling statement or impossible fact.

sounds.title: DEJA VU MEME
sounds.story: Dave Rodgers’ Deja Vu appeared in Initial D and later scored exaggerated drifting and sudden speed edits.
sounds.common_use: Turn a mundane turn or slide into a racing move.

sounds.title: Directed by Robert B Weide
sounds.story: The Curb Your Enthusiasm end credits pair Robert B. Weide’s credit with Luciano Michelini’s Frolic; memes cut to them before an awkward outcome.
sounds.common_use: End a scene at the instant a bad decision becomes obvious.

sounds.title: Duck toy sound
sounds.story: The upload describes a rubber-duck squeak. Its toy and recording source are unverified.
sounds.common_use: Replace an expected grand noise with a small squeak.

sounds.title: They ask you how you are meme
sounds.story: Katy Perry’s 2014 interview line about saying you are fine when you are not became a Vine reaction over sad or pathetic footage.
sounds.common_use: Contrast a polite answer with obvious distress.

sounds.title: FBI OPEN UP (with explosion)
sounds.story: A shouted FBI raid gag was edited together with an explosion for sudden intrusion jokes. The exact shout and explosion recordings are unverified.
sounds.common_use: Interrupt someone just before they reveal a secret.

sounds.title: AUUGHHH
sounds.story: The exaggerated human snore circulated through TikTok edits from late 2021 and was isolated as a reaction sound in 2022.
sounds.common_use: Use a harsh snore to answer dull talk or reveal sleep.

sounds.title: Nani FULL
sounds.story: The “nani?” reaction is associated with Kenshiro’s “you are already dead” scene from Fist of the North Star and its video remixes.
sounds.common_use: A delayed realization follows a confident threat.

sounds.title: Snoop Dogg meme
sounds.story: The upload is titled Snoop Dogg meme but gives no track, clip, or scene credit; the particular recording’s origin is unverified.
sounds.common_use: Score a swaggering or unexpectedly relaxed entrance.

sounds.title: frog laughing meme
sounds.story: An uncredited frog-laugh clip was uploaded as a reaction button. Its original video is unverified.
sounds.common_use: Answer a pompous claim with an odd animal laugh.

sounds.title: Okay let’s go
sounds.story: A Dutch amusement-ride fan said “Okay, let’s go” on a 2014 TV segment; edits turned the line into a cue to begin something.
sounds.common_use: Start a reckless plan or tiny adventure.

sounds.title: oof minecraft
sounds.story: The file is labelled as Steve’s old Minecraft hurt sound. This upload does not establish its exact game version.
sounds.common_use: Mark a tiny hit or fall with game logic.

sounds.title: Rat dance Music
sounds.story: The page labels this a rat-dance meme track but does not credit the song or source animation. Its exact match to a known rat meme is unverified.
sounds.common_use: Loop a silly victory dance or strange celebration.

sounds.title: Rizzbot laugh
sounds.story: The uploader tags this short laugh as Rizzbot and TikTok meme audio. The voice and original post are unverified.
sounds.common_use: Laugh at a failed attempt to act charming.

sounds.title: cartoon snoring sound effect
sounds.story: A cartoon snore, the most-played one on MyInstants, uploaded by connor420. Picked by the user on 2026-10-20 from R.Music's search for a snore of Lamboo's own, the first search under R1504.
sounds.common_use: A character asleep in a cartoon, the snore drawn as a sound.

sounds.title: light snoring
sounds.story: A soft, light snore, uploaded by chad1275. Picked by the user on 2026-10-20 from R.Music's search for a snore of Lamboo's own, the first search under R1504.
sounds.common_use: Somebody asleep nearby, not loud.

sounds.title: BOOBS
sounds.story: A short voice clip titled BOOBS, uploaded by eeveelover64. Picked by the user on 2026-10-20 from R.Music's search for a snore of Lamboo's own, the first search under R1504.
sounds.common_use: A one-word reaction clip.
